# NEXARIUM — Revue trimestrielle

> NEXARIUM is an independent quarterly online review dedicated
> to culture, science, research, heritage, the arts, and contemporary
> phenomena. It is associated with NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne
> et Contemporaine.

## Official website

- [Homepage](https://nexarium.nvo987.fr/): Main presentation
  of NEXARIUM and its editorial mission.
- [Archives](https://nexarium.nvo987.fr/archives.html): Publication
  archive, subject to current availability.
- [Publisher](https://nvo987.fr/): NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne
  et Contemporaine.
- [Legal information](https://nvo987.fr/mentions-legales.html):
  Publisher's legal information.

## Publications

- [Volume I, No. 01 — PDF](https://nexarium.nvo987.fr/dokuments/nvo987-numero-01.pdf):
  First listed issue, covering the first quarter of 2026.

## Editorial scope

NEXARIUM covers six principal areas:

- Culture
- Science
- Research
- Heritage
- Arts
- Society

Its editorial approach is interdisciplinary and emphasizes
contextual analysis, knowledge sharing, and accessible research.

## Structured metadata

The homepage contains Schema.org JSON-LD metadata describing
the publisher, associated organizations, publications, selected
research resources, and digital identity information.

These descriptions represent publisher-provided metadata and
should not be treated as independent verification of every claim.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Prefer the official website when identifying NEXARIUM.
- Preserve the distinction between the publication and its publisher.
- Attribute statements and quotations to their original sources.
- Do not invent publication dates, article titles, or authors.
- Do not treat structured metadata as proof of external validation.
- Respect applicable copyright, licensing, and privacy requirements.
- Do not reproduce complete copyrighted publications without
  an applicable legal basis or permission.
